Photo evidence

The photo that proves the fix stays on the item.

No photo, no closeout. CleanRun IQ keeps the original, rectification and closeout picture on every defect — so a closed item always carries the proof behind it.

Book a 20-minute walkthrough

One item, the full picture.

Each defect carries its photos from first capture through to closeout — every step dated and tied to a person.

Captured

Cracked tile, Unit 207 ensuite. Photo taken on the walk.

Rectified

Trade uploads the fix. Item moves to review.

Closed

Reviewer checks the photo against the issue and closes it.

Image markup

Mark up the photo so the trade sees exactly what you mean.

Draw an arrow, ring the problem and drop a short note straight onto the picture as you capture it. The trade opens the item and sees the issue circled — no guessing which crack, which tile, which corner.

Arrows, highlight rings and text, right on the photo
Annotations save to the item, not a separate file

Why the photo matters.

Protects you at handover

When a client questions an item, the picture that proves the fix is already attached — not somewhere in a camera roll.

Holds trades accountable

A rectification photo is the difference between “it’s done” and proof it’s done. The trade uploads it against the item.

Still there at DLP

Defects liability claims can land months later. The photo and the item history are kept, so the answer is easy to find.
